notes.title: 😃Patch #15 - Creative Mode!
notes.notes:
Well it has been a hot minute 🔥 as they say! But we’ve finally had some time to set up an update for Spacefolk City that brings with it several features that players have been requesting!👷Read on 👀

[h1]Creative Mode! ⚒️[/h1]

It’s finally here! 🏁 Spacefolk City has always had a Sandbox mode, allowing you to play without any specific objectives to complete, but our wonderful players have always requested a mode where they can just build freely, right from the get-go. Well, Chris has worked a little of his magic 🪄and set up for us a true Creative Mode 💡 where you can start a game with Scrap all ready to use. Each level has a warehouse holding a set amount of Scrap so you can just get right into some juicy construction, straight away. 🏃

We can’t wait to see what amazing cities you build with this! 😻

[h1]Interest Selection ✅[/h1]

Another feature that players often request is the ability to choose which species of Folk are present in their cities at the start of each game. This is now made possible! Once you’ve encountered Folk for the first time, they will be available to choose when you start a new game in any level. You can finally make that freaky Mushroom Rock Banana Pizza mash-up you’ve always dreamed of. 🍄🎸🍌🍕

[h1]New Levels ✨[/h1]

And finally, some new levels to play! 🕹️ These are available through the newly re-arranged Top Menu for players who have completed the initial Tutorial level.

[h1]Bug Fixes 🪲[/h1]

Chris has also hunted down a few pesky bugs that were reported by players, so hopefully you should see some little improvements here and there.

~~~

Huge love and thanks to our players, many who have been playing for some years now! ♥️ We really appreciate the kind comments about the game, and hearing of the joy it brings people.

Join our Discord too, to come hang out with wonderful friendly players like YOU  👉 [url=https://linktr.ee/MoonModeGames]https://linktr.ee/MoonModeGames[/url]

[i]Rosie, Chris and Alex @ Moon Mode[/i]

notes.title: 📸🏴‍☠️ Big Update: Pirate Fish & Handy Cam!
notes.notes:
[h1]AVAST!! X MARKS THE SPOT!! 🏴‍☠️[/h1]

Blow me down and shiver me timbers, it finally be ‘ere! To celebrate Talk Like a Pirate Day 2022, we’re happy to announce that our new update is shipshape and ready to set sail! Introducing a new folk species, the 🎉 PIRATE FISH! 🎉 Splice the mainbrace and pass out the grog! All hand hoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373031/dee166c38590e7bfcbbfb8275b0652d0158716b3.png[/img]
[i]Sink me if these scallywags aren’t the cutest![/i]

Build a Skill Facility to activate their special ability: they’ll dig for treasure and heave up a coffer of Scrap! To complement this, we’ve added some new levels that have fewer asteroids, so you’ll need to keep these seadogs busy digging up Scrap for your skullduggery! There’s also a new song Alex has whipped up for the occasion, aptly named “Pirate Fish”. It’s no sea-shanty, but it’s got a right smelly pirate funk about it!

[h2]✋ BUT WAIT THERE’S MORE ❗[/h2]
(always wanted to say that)

We’ve also added a new camera for taking pictures of your cities! We love seeing your extraordinary city creations when you share them with us, so we wanted to make this easier. The camera has settings for aspect ratio and zoom, and because you can freely position it independent of your head, it’s now far easier to get great dramatic photos of your creations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373031/26ab3fbe1db5e1f46806c6c1c8cf8b2a68a0ffc3.png[/img]

Photos are saved to the "Pictures" folder on your PC, ready to share!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373031/ddf9e809ce4b9ad1581562bd0ebd84e4d7e9f02c.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy this update! We’re looking forward to seeing all the amazing photos you share, and hearing all your tales on the open seas! Ahoy me hearties! (OK this pirate talk thing is getting dry now 😆 but anywayz… Pirate Fish!!! 🐟🏴‍☠️)

As always, we’d love to have you on our Discord, or following us on Twitter. All the links are here:
👉 https://linktr.ee/MoonModeGames

Thank you for playing Spacefolk City!

[i]Therése, Chris and Alex @ Moon Mode[/i]

notes.title: 🏠 Patch #10

It's patch time! This time it's not really a patch, but rather some little additions which we've been meaning to do for some time. [h2]💡 New Features[/h2]

notes.title: 📈 Patch #9!
notes.notes:
We are back with Patch #9! Once again this is a bug fix patch! No incredible new features 😞 but a load of bug fixes 😃 to things which our wonderful fantabulous players have reported on our Discord 📡 Thank you as always for your support!

[h2]💡 New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Not really a new "feature" per se, but Chris has made it a bit more intuitive when scrap is consumed from around the city. Now it will fly from around the city (or warehouses) to items you pull out of the store, just to make it more clear that pulling items from the store consumes scrap. 📉📈
[*] Not really a new feature either, but trashed decor items now correctly return a portion of their scrap cost to the player! 💸
[*]  The largest facilities (that need 3 interests to work) are now locked until you actually have 3 interests - hopefully this will lead to less issues for new players! 🏢

[/list]

[h2]👾 Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some issues with overly bright lights
[*] Fixed an issue with homes losing their colouration if you remove or re-add decorations during construction.
[*] Addressed some localisation errors.
[*] Fixed a problem where a folk's home heart would never come back if you TNT'ed the home and then rebuilt it.
[*] Fixed an issue with the “Has seen 5 items” heart disappearing
[*] Fixed an issue with the “Been to Birthday party” heart not saving
[*] Fixed a rare problem where folk would try and get scrap that had fallen into space.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Warehouse job - folk now also collect scrap from Refineries properly.
[*] Defence stations now correctly cease to function if the power station is destroyed.
[*] Fixed an issue with Facility banners incorrectly displaying "Put Back" for certain decor items.
[*] Changed behaviour of construction folk so they can again pull scrap from Warehouses even if they're not accessible.
[*] Trashed decor items now correctly return a portion of their scrap cost to the player.
[*] Fixed an issue with Defence Beacon folk continuing to work even after the Beacon was destroyed.
[/list]

We would love to hear from you and see your cities! Come by our Discord to say hi and share your city images with our wonderful community of players:
👉 https://linktr.ee/MoonModeGames

Thanks for playing Spacefolk City! 👋

[i]Therése, Chris and Alex @ Moon Mode[/i]

notes.title: 🌞 Patch #7!
notes.notes:
It's been a hot minute since our last post, but we're back with another fairly extensive bug-fix update! 🛠 Chris and co. have been hard at work to address a few of the smaller niggles that our lovely players have noticed, as well as some other ones which have been flying under the radar. 📡

There is one nice new addition though, which should help open up some new layout possibilities! Read on! 👇👀

[h2]💡 New Features[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373031/f9c5f94ed6df1fed6259d4420996a0ed43d25143.png[/img]
[b]Half-Steps![/b] You asked for them and here they are! Half-steps open up a range of simpler solutions to spatial problems, allowing you to make full use of half-sized height differences between floors. You can also attach stairs to stairs, but stairs must always be connected to some part of the city, so no building the stairway to heaven off into deep space, I'm afraid 🤣 But this has been something players have requested for some time, so it's great to finally have them in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373031/0e9683295c2506ce21cc48c346a1eecdec48112f.png[/img]
[b]Sleep Indicators[/b] We've added indicators above Folks' heads that show when they're tired and wanting to go home to sleep. This information was previously visible in the folk UI panel (visible when you pick up a folk), but having it show all the time will hopefully make it easier to understand what's going on when folk are too sleepy to cooperate! 🛏💤

[h2]👾 Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem with the bus not bringing new folk in some situations
[*]Fixed some localisation problems
[*]Fixed a problem with the banana slide not working if you take it from a folk
[*]Fixed overlapping speech bubbles
[*]Fixed issues with the spatial location of asteroid stretching and popping sounds
[*]Ladders have placement rays emitted perpendicular to their direction
[*]Fixed an issue with folks prioritising interacting with items over their jobs. If a folk is heading to interact with something rather than doing their job, you can now drag them to a doorway of their job assignment to... "erm... "politely coerce" them into working instead 😆
[*]Fixed an issue where TNT wouldn't appear in Interest Shop pages
[*]Fixed some cases of lag occurring when moving items on buildings
[*]Added a missing birthday ability sound! 🎉
[*]Folk should not get additional items from buildings if they're already holding one
[*]Ensured that you can not build on top of clouds
[*]Fixed a problem with all folk simultaneously having thoughts on load of savegames
[*]Other performance optimisations and miscellanous fixes to folk behaviour 
[/list]

All being well, our next update should be a bit more substantial in terms of new features! Stay tuned! 👀

As always, an open invitation to come join our Discord! It's a great place to share your city builds, chat with us about Spacefolk City, or report problems! Hope to see you there!
👉 https://linktr.ee/MoonModeGames

Happy building, and thanks for playing Spacefolk City! We hope you're enjoying it 👋

[i]Therése, Chris and Alex @ Moon Mode[/i]

notes.title: Patch #6 🧹
notes.notes:
Spring is upon us (at least here in the northern hemisphere!) and the time is right for some Spring cleaning ☁🧹 This update we focussed on bug fixing and tightening things up on the backend 🔧

We do have two new little features for you though, to expand on the multiple save-game functionality added last month. Details below 👀

[h2]💡 New Features[/h2]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373031/b773fdb09aaf0ae99f56601bd6ab20c5a7e8ca4c.png[/img]
[*] [b]Folk Species on Title[/b] You can now see which Folk types you’ve found throughout all your play sessions on the title menu. Handy for the inner-collector in all of us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373031/182bf9ad04912a12aa52cd183b9b00a38f8ffca3.png[/img]
[*] [b]Save Game Objectives[/b] Save game slots now also show you which objectives you've completed.
[/list]

[h2]👾 Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Art Folks’ broken speech bubble line when their ability is activated.
[*] Fixed VFX issues with Folks’ abilities.
[*] Fixed an issue with some Folks’ Interest titles being grammatically incorrect during their intros.
[*] Decorative items now correctly explode if TNT is attached to them.
[*] Fixed endless parties from the Birthday Folk if you pick them up during their party. 😆
[*] Fixed an issue on Oculus Rift where new games were overwriting the Slot 1 save game.
[*] The correct SFX is now triggered when new Folk arrive in the city.
[*] The correct SFX is now triggered when you expand, compress or duplicate items.
[*] Reduced volume of Folk ability activation SFX
[*] Fixed folk facing the wrong way when working at Refineries
[*] Fixed an issue with the stretching sound continuing to play if you let go of an asteroid with one hand while stretching.
[/list]
We're doing our best to keep up with the bugs and get the game where it needs to be! We have some other improvements and additions on the way too, so [i]watch this space[/i] 👀

Please do join us on our Discord too! We love seeing the cities you build, and it's also the best place to report bugs if you find them. Hope to see you there! Links are here: 👉 https://linktr.ee/MoonModeGames

Until next month! 👋 Hope you enjoy Spacefolk City.

[i]Therése, Chris and Alex @ Moon Mode[/i]
